resources.title: Five-Minute Reset
resources.summary: Use a short pause to reset before the next study task.
steps: Step away from the screen or notebook.
Take several slow breaths.
Drink water or stretch gently.
Choose one small task before returning.

resources.title: How to Reduce Today's Task List
resources.summary: Review the plan and move, split, or lower the priority of one task.
steps: List only the tasks scheduled for today.
Choose the most important task to keep.
Move one lower-priority task to tomorrow or another date.
Split one large task into two smaller steps.

resources.title: Planning a Lighter Review Day
resources.summary: Create a lighter day that still keeps the study habit moving.
steps: Choose one topic that needs maintenance review.
Use a shorter review block.
Correct a few mistakes instead of starting a large new set.
End with a brief summary.

resources.title: Preparing to Talk With a Trusted Adult
resources.summary: Prepare a simple message before asking someone for help.
steps: Write what feels difficult right now.
Name one kind of help you want.
Ask for a short time to talk.
Share only the information you choose.

resources.title: Questions to Ask a School Counsellor
resources.summary: Use these prompts when planning a conversation with a school counsellor.
steps: Ask how to review your workload.
Ask what school supports may be available.
Ask how to plan around upcoming deadlines.
Ask how to talk with a teacher if you need help.
